description: hlc.rs HlcClock::receive() has a three-level nested if/else structure comparing wall_ms and logical counters. The logic is correct but hard to follow because the branch conditions are spread across three levels. Flattening into a match on (wall_ms.cmp(&other.wall_ms), logical.cmp(&other.logical)) with exhaustive arms, or extracting a max_hlc helper, would make the causal ordering logic immediately readable.
title: core: hlc.rs receive() has deeply nested if/else chain; extract to match or helper
